mission: AI acts as the user-facing orchestrator; independently versioned deterministic tools validate facts, render artifacts and prove source lineage
human_interface: Natural language request and explicit approval only; no routine manual spreadsheet/LaTeX/software operation expected
computer_interface: Versioned schemas, source digest manifests, stable PK/FK identities, pure-source transformers, local/private authorized executors, GitHub actions for public-safe fixtures, provider readback
never_do: Trust chat memory or generated wording as source authority
Invent engineering quantities, contractual rates, scientific findings, signatures or approvals
Upload private company/research inputs to public GitHub Actions
Treat two equal prompts as identical inputs when live source revisions differ
Delete legacy originals or uncontrolled normalized copies
Retry file ingestion blindly after an ambiguous tool timeout

determinism.limits: Identical natural-language prompts, unpinned online data, AI interpretation, and generated PDF metadata cannot be guaranteed bitwise identical. Exact 100/100 correctness is not scientifically guaranteed.
determinism.fail_closed: Missing/changed evidence, missing approvals or runtime mismatch -> HOLD or FAILED; never invent substitutions.

execution_bridge.note: A real private authenticated job runner is needed to fetch company/private academic records and perform authorized writes. The website is not yet a full document-builder app.
